svg.title: F15-7 Load bank sequence of one 2,880 kW set and the coolant trend at 100 %
svg.text: F15-7 Load bank sequence of one 2,880 kW set and the coolant trend at 100 %
B2-GEN-07, 20 kV, DCC rating · steps 0, 25, 50, 75 and 100 % · 100 % held 4 h (NFPA 110 acceptance needs 2 h) · total 5.83 h · coolant stable at 88 °C for the last 3 h,
example alarm 98 °C · room rise 9.3 K against 10 K design
• Step 5 starts after 1 h 40 min of lower steps and runs 4 h; the readings at 10:00 to 14:00 belong to it.
• Stable means less than 1 °C change over the last 30 min; the coolant reads 88 °C from 11:00 to 14:00.
• The room rise reaches 9.3 K, inside the 10 K design value; outdoor temperature is recorded beside it.
